name: assign_draft_cache_locs_contiguous
description: Speculative draft-cache gather with signature assign_draft_cache_locs_contiguous(req_pool_indices, req_to_token, seq_lens, out_cache_loc, topk, speculative_num_steps). For each request r < req_pool_indices.numel(), read n = topk*speculative_num_steps entries req_to_token[req_pool_indices[r], seq_lens[r]:seq_lens[r]+n] using req_to_token's own row stride and write them contiguously to out_cache_loc[r*n:(r+1)*n]. The native wrapper writes out_cache_loc in place and returns that same tensor; the reference returns an updated clone. out_cache_loc is therefore mutated. With zero requests no elements are written and the input is returned unchanged. The suite exercises int32 inputs, topk 1/4/8 and steps 1/3/5.
